title: A Proof of the Jung-Kim Conjecture on the Centers of Walled Brauer Algebras
summary: We give a unified account of the five families of Khovanov arc algebras $K_n^m$, $K_n^{-\infty}$, $K_n^{+\infty}$, $K_n^\infty$ and $K_\infty^\infty$ in the framework of level-two tensor product categorifications, making explicit a perspective familiar to specialists. Our main application is a proof of the Jung--Kim conjecture: over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, the centre of every walled Brauer algebra is generated by supersymmetric polynomials in its Jucys--Murphy elements.
